risks.risk: Compatibility risk: the gearbox may not match the exact Camry year/engine/gearbox variant (and '22 pin' may be wrong), leading to refusal to fit or immediate failure.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (part number) and the transmission code stamped on the casing, plus the connector/pin layout photo.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: wrong/uncertain fit and not guaranteed to work; treat as non-verified used gearbox.

risks.risk: Condition risk: internal wear, missing parts, or damage not visible in a single photo (e.g., worn clutches/solenoids, leaks, broken components).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being tested (bench test or installed test) showing it engages all gears and no abnormal noise/leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not proven working; assume possible faults.

risks.risk: Missing components risk: torque converter, sensors, harness/solenoids, or mounting brackets may be missing or mismatched.

risks.risk: Leak/contamination risk: fluid leaks or metal debris inside can’t be confirmed from photo alone.
